name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench, grip bar shoulder-width apart. Lower bar to chest, then press back up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30–45°. Press dumbbells up and slightly inward at top.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to -15°. Lower bar to lower chest, press back up.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Stand between cables set at shoulder height. With slight elbow bend, arc hands together.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart. Lower chest to floor, press back up keeping core tight.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Lean forward on parallel bars. Dip until upper arms are parallel, press back up.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie across bench. Hold dumbbell overhead, lower behind head then pull back.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar, palms facing away. Pull until chin clears bar, lower slowly.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from bar, palms facing you. Pull until chin clears bar.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward 45°. Pull bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place knee and hand on bench. Row dumbbell to hip, keeping elbow close.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar wide. Pull down to upper chest while leaning slightly back.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright. Pull handle to abdomen, squeezing shoulder blades at end.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hip-width stance, bar over mid-foot. Drive hips forward as bar passes knees. Keep back neutral.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle bar, hinge forward. Pull bar to chest, squeezing back muscles.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height. Pull rope to face while pulling elbows back and out.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at collar-bone level. Press overhead to lockout, keep core braced.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand. Press dumbbells from ear level up to lockout.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Slight elbow bend. Raise arms out to sides to shoulder height, control the descent.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height. Avoid swinging.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward 90°. Raise arms out to sides with slight elbow bend.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you. Rotate and press simultaneously to lockout.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Pull bar up to chin level, leading with elbows. Keep bar close to body.

name: Shrugs
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears, hold briefly, lower slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Underhand grip. Curl bar from hip to shoulder level, keep elbows at sides.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Alternate or simultaneous curls. Supinate wrist at top of movement.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip (palms facing each other). Curl to shoulder height.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest arms on preacher pad. Curl bar up, lower slowly for maximum stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit, rest elbow on inner thigh. Curl dumbbell to shoulder, squeeze at top.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing low pulley. Curl handle up, maintaining constant tension.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at high pulley. Push handle down to full extension, elbows at sides.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie flat. Lower bar to forehead by bending elbows, then extend back up.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead. Lower behind head by bending elbows, then extend.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip bar shoulder-width or closer. Lower to chest, press focusing on triceps.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Upright torso on parallel bars. Lower until elbows are 90°, press back up.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to floor. Extend forearm back to lockout.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps. Squat to at least parallel, keeping chest up and knees tracking toes.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar on front delts. Upright torso, squat deep, drive elbows up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Place feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower until knees form 90°, press back.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hip hinge with slight knee bend. Lower bar along legs feeling hamstring stretch, return to standing.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit upright. Extend legs to full lockout, lower slowly.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Squat front leg to 90°, drive through heel to stand.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Feet low on platform. Squat until thighs parallel, drive back up.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward, lower back knee toward floor. Return to standing, alternate legs.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with balls of feet on edge. Raise heels as high as possible, lower below starting point.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, feet flat. Drive hips up squeezing glutes at top, lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on floor, body straight. Hold position breathing steadily.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Curl upper body toward knees, lower controlled.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise straight legs to 90° (or higher), lower slowly.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit, feet off floor. Rotate torso side to side, touching floor each side.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel, roll wheel forward until body is extended, pull back using core.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at high pulley. Crunch rope to floor, keeping hips still.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Push-up position. Drive alternating knees to chest rapidly.
